# telnyx_agent_gateway_mcp_server (Resource)

An MCP server whose tools an Agent Gateway exposes to its keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_agent_gateway_mcp_server" "docs" {
  gateway_id = telnyx_agent_gateway.example.id
  name       = "docs"
  url        = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"
  transport  = "http"

  auth_wo = jsonencode({
    type  = "bearer_token"
    value = var.docs_mcp_token
  })
  auth_wo_version = 1
}

variable "docs_mcp_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.
- `name` (String) A name for the server, unique on the instance across MCP servers and APIs, regardless of case. Letters, digits, `_`, and `.`. The gateway prefixes the server's tools with it and a hyphen.
- `url` (String) The server's MCP endpoint.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `auth_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The server's outbound authentication method. Credentials are never returned. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`. Write-only: never stored in state. Change `auth_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `auth_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send `auth_wo` again; Terraform cannot detect a change to a value it does not store.
- `forwarded_headers` (Set of String) Headers copied from the agent's request, by name.
- `open_to_every_key` (Boolean) `true` lets every key on the instance use the server, granted or not.
- `static_headers` (String, Sensitive) Headers sent on every request. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `tools` (Set of String) The tools the server exposes to every key, by name. `[]` exposes every tool.
- `transport` (String) `http` for Streamable HTTP, or `sse` for Server-Sent Events. One of `http`, `sse`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Identifies the server.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_agent_gateway_mcp_server.docs <gateway_id>/<id>
```
